sn10.9:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn10.9:1.2: Now on that occasion the bhikkhuni Sukka, surrounded by a large assembly, was teaching the Dhamma.
sn10.9:1.3: Then a yakkha who had full confidence in the bhikkhuni Sukka, going from street to street and from square to square in Rajagaha, on that occasion recited these verses:
sn10.9:2.1: “What has happened to these people in Rajagaha?
sn10.9:2.2: They sleep as if they've been drinking mead.
sn10.9:2.3: Why don’t they attend on Sukka
sn10.9:2.4: As she teaches the deathless state?
sn10.9:3.2: as it were, drink it up—
